Lina Chen: gluten-free note: whole family is GF, so maybe gf cupcakes?
Marisol Vega: noted. gf cupcakes + sparkling water it is. also tiny toast? 2 min tops. :speech_balloon:
Samir Khan: 2 min toast is perfect. thanks for being so quick to celebrate 64f
CalendarBot: event created: "Samir + Lina: Vows + Samir Promo" Fri 12:301:00 @Kitchenette. https://calendar.company/evt/2142000000

Samir Khan: youve saved the day. thank you. also pls no team roast, keep it warm :smile:
